meta.name: db-seed
meta.description: Generate database seed scripts with realistic sample data. Reads Drizzle schemas or SQL migrations, respects foreign key ordering, produces idempotent TypeScript or SQL seed files. Handles D1 batch limits, unique constraints, and domain-appropriate data. Use when populating dev/demo/test databases. Triggers: 'seed database', 'seed data', 'sample data', 'populate database', 'db seed', 'test data', 'demo data', 'generate fixtures'.

copy.tagline: 根据数据库模式生成带真实感数据的种子脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在开发或测试数据库中快速填充符合表结构的样本数据。
